biggest_catch: Every task has a fixed, non-negotiable payout set by the brand — but official pages never publish a per-video rate, so you cannot plan earnings until you apply; the '$500/month average creator' claim is marketing, not a guarantee.
catches: Each task's payout is fixed and set by the brand — 'No, you can't negotiate your rate.' What you see before applying is what you get.

Official pages publish no per-video pay range; the only concrete official figure is the help center's claim that 'on average, Billo creator earns 500 dollars per month' — an average, not a floor or promise.
Vetted creator network: you must apply and be accepted as a creator; not everyone is admitted.
5-day video deadline per task; missing it hurts your On-Time score and repeat non-delivery can get you suspended — and suspended creators can be charged the product price.
Paid every two weeks via PayPal for approved videos; brands have 3 business days to review (auto-approved if they don't act).

steps: Apply to become a Billo creator via the official site and pass their creator vetting (5,000+ vetted creators; acceptance is not automatic).
Add your PayPal account details to your creator profile — payouts only go to PayPal.
Browse available tasks: each task shows its set, non-negotiable payout before you apply.
Apply to a task and, once approved, receive the product/brief.
Create and upload the video within the 5-day deadline (missing it hurts your On-Time score; repeated misses can get you suspended).
The brand has 3 business days to review; if they take no action the video auto-approves.
Receive payment: approved videos are paid out twice a month via PayPal (arrives same day or within 1-2 workdays).
timing: Money transfers for all approved videos twice a month (every two weeks); funds arrive same day or within 1-2 workdays of the transfer.
